source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Modular Ice Maker Service Sheet (Part 2225623, 120 V)
source.oemTestTitle: Electronic model ice maker service codes

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before resistance checks or module removal. Restore power only for live voltage checks when required.
steps.sourceExcerpt: MODULE OHMMETER CHECKS (no power; ejector blades in PARK).

steps.title: Which test 56 code is displayed?
steps.body: French-door / electronic models show IME codes during service test 56. Modular 2225623 uses L/N/M/T/H/V test points.
steps.sourceExcerpt: French-door / electronic models show IME codes during service test 56. Modular 2225623 uses L/N/M/T/H/V test points.

steps.title: IME2 — motor path
steps.body: Run w2225623-motor-circuit: L–M should read 8800 Ω off support; verify cam "D" coupling alignment.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run w2225623-motor-circuit: L–M should read 8800 Ω off support; verify cam "D" coupling alignment.

steps.title: IME3 — heater / bimetal / fuse path
steps.body: Run w2225623-mold-heater (L–H 72 Ω), w2225623-bimetal (T–H), and w2225623-harness-fuse (IMFUSE).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run w2225623-mold-heater (L–H 72 Ω), w2225623-bimetal (T–H), and w2225623-harness-fuse (IMFUSE).

steps.title: E4 or E5 displayed?
steps.body: E4/IME4 = dry cycle (no water). E5/IME5 = thermistor on electronic models; modular uses bimetal T–H.
steps.sourceExcerpt: E4/IME4 = dry cycle (no water). E5/IME5 = thermistor on electronic models; modular uses bimetal T–H.

steps.title: IME4 — water fill path
steps.body: Run w2225623-water-valve: N–V valve voltage and 140 cc / 7.5 s fill specification.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Run w2225623-water-valve: N–V valve voltage and 140 cc / 7.5 s fill specification.

steps.title: IME5 — bimetal substitute
steps.body: On modular 2225623, harvest thermostat is bimetal T–H (not thermistor). Run w2225623-bimetal procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: On modular 2225623, harvest thermostat is bimetal T–H (not thermistor). Run w2225623-bimetal procedure.

steps.title: IME2 path complete
steps.oemOutcome: Motor L–M and cam coupling checked per 2225623 sheet.

steps.title: IME3 path complete
steps.oemOutcome: Heater, bimetal, and harness fuse checked per 2225623 sheet.

steps.title: IME4 path complete
steps.oemOutcome: Water valve N–V and fill volume checked per 2225623 sheet.

steps.title: IME5 path complete
steps.oemOutcome: Bimetal T–H checked — modular module has no mold thermistor.
